title: Design system contract
description: The app's design-system facts that check-design-system and check-raw-values read: where the token file is, which theme export copies which token path, the palettes, the text and font facts, and the raw-value policy. Paths are repo-relative.

tokens.description: The token file (two tiers, aliases as {a.b.c}).

token.description: Dot path into the token file.
Dot path to { light, dark, colorBlind? } in the token file.

invariantFields.description: Colour roles that must be identical in every palette (white-label flavours).

files.description: Overrides of the default module paths by key: themeTypes, tokens, typeStyles, motion, fonts, palette, contrast, themeSet, themeContext, useTheme, makeStyles, themeProvider, textLocale, textStyle, shadowStyles, appText, balancedWrap, pressSurface, pressFeedback.

fonts.description: The font decision, always declared. "system" (the template default): the platform's own font (San Francisco, Roboto), nothing bundled, and the font-files, font-plugin and no-font-weight rules are off. An object: the bundled font files, pinned by sha256, with their licences; every rule then applies strictly.

weightBy.description: family (default): a file and a family per weight, never fontWeight. fontWeight: one family name per font plus fontWeight (Expo's android.fonts object syntax).

scan.description: Folders check-raw-values scans. Default: the src folder minus src/core, src/data, src/api, src/stores, src/services, src/i18n and src/config.
